title: [AINews] Modal’s $1B ARR, $16B Series D makes it NYC’s newest AI Infra Decacorn, 3x usage and 3x valuation in 5 months, 15x in 1 yr
summary: Today Modal switches from our infra unicorn category to infra decacorn . Sandboxes exploded and three years later, it’s a $300M run rate product just on its own.
takeaways: Use cases range from background agents, to reinforcement learning, vibecoding platforms, and much more.
It also used ~30% fewer tokens than Claude models ( Cline ).
